info.title: Port_Access_GBP_Action_Set
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_GBP_Action_Set](#/Port_Access_GBP_Action_Set)
The group of actions associated with this policy entry. The actions group is applied to each entry of the associated class. The actions group specified in this policy entry is defined in [Port_Access_GBP_Actions] (Port_Access_GBP_Actions)

drop.description: Drop packets matching the criteria specified in an associated class entry. If drop is specified, then all other actions will be ignored.

origin.description: Origin of the policy action set, i.e., how the policy action set is provisioned.  `local`:       policy action set is provisioned locally on the device.  `synthesized`: policy action set has been dynamically synthesized                 by the system.

parameters.name: Port_Access_GBP.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_GBP](#/Port_Access_GBP)
Port Access Group Based Policy name.

parameters.name: Port_Access_GBP_Entry.sequence_number
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_GBP_Entry](#/Port_Access_GBP_Entry)
Policy entries as configured by the user. GBP policy entries must only be associated with GBP class entries. The policy is rejected if any associated classes that are of type other than GBP.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)

drop.description: Drop packets matching the criteria specified in an associated class entry. If drop is specified, then all other actions will be ignored.
